Nearly a year after #MeToo became a large scale national movement, I'm grimly bemused by those who think it was a fad, like fidget-spinners. 

We're working to stop sexually abusive persons & helping survivors heal. 

We're not stopping at all ever.

Is *anyone* going to be surprised if Brett Kavanaugh turns out to be a #MeToo man? 

His track record already shows he hates women. 

And Sen Feinstein doesn't just randomly turn over materials to the FBI.

#StopKavanaugh

That was the first thing I thought of, too. 

Sean Penn & Alec Baldwin have each gone out of their way to try to discredit the #MeToo movement & it really, really seems like a preemptive strike:

1/2 After Seattle's #StopKavanaugh rally on Sat, three workers for the city--two Black, one Latinix--saw my white friend & me carrying our signs.

They completely agreed w/ us. 

But their concern was that Bill Cosby would be the only prominent #MeToo man to serve time.

Washington Lawyers for the Arts is a great non-profit.

Was about to explain basic legal tenets to an ostensible peer who still doesn't understand why his reporting of a #MeToo story was both inaccurate & gutless & I'm sending him the link instead:

https://t.co/3eIPPNpcdc

P.S. I've already tried explaining said facts to the ostensible peer in question. 

He's either incredibly obtuse or cowardly or both. 

Either way, if he's going to report #MeToo stories, he can sit down w/ an attorney. 

Maybe there's hope for him yet.

Okay, on one hand, we have all of recorded human history up until Oct '17.

On the other, a single year since #MeToo went global.

Think pieces: "WHY HASN'T METOO CHANGED EVERYTHING FOR ALL TIME EVER? HAS IT FAILED?"

No, it hasn't failed. 

IT'S JUST GETTING STARTED.

P.S. Please note I said "one year since #MeToo went global".

Of course, @TaranaBurke changed history when she created it over a decade ago.

@TaranaBurke Ms. Burke, thank you. 

I'm among the millions whose lives changed as a result of #MeToo . 

Please know how many of us will continue to work undeterred on behalf of one another and on behalf of the movement.

Much gratitude.

All the best to you and yours.
